summary.ko: 목표·대상·제작 여건에 맞춘 채널별 콘텐츠 계획과 제작 요구사항을 만듭니다.
summary.en: Plan channel-specific content around business goals, audience value, and realistic production capacity.

triggers: plan a month of social posts

required_inputs.description: Audience, goals, channels, content pillars, and approved claims
Planning period, cadence, known dates, and production capacity

workflow.instruction: Define a limited set of content pillars and the audience value each should provide.
Distribute formats and topics across the requested period using real deadlines and available production capacity.
Specify the angle, intended action, asset needs, owner assumptions, and draft copy direction for each slot.
Check repetition, factual claims, approval lead time, and workload; mark tentative dates and missing assets.

deliverables.name: Content calendar
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Each item has date, channel, pillar, topic, format, asset needs, CTA, and status

limitations: Do not invent holidays, launches, or claimed platform performance.
Posting times are assumptions unless supported by the account’s data.
permission_boundaries: Do not schedule or publish posts, buy engagement, or import audience data.
Do not use private customer stories or unapproved personal images.
